steps.en: Install qpdf from your distribution or drop in a release binary
steps.zh: 从发行版安装 qpdf，或直接放一个 release 二进制

steps.en: Run one command naming the input, the transformations and the output
steps.zh: 一条命令写明输入、要做的变换和输出

steps.en: Parses each file's object graph, rebuilding a damaged cross-reference table if needed
steps.zh: 解析每个文件的对象图，交叉引用表坏了就重建

steps.en: Copies, drops or re-encrypts objects; page content streams are carried over unchanged
steps.zh: 在对象层面复制、删除或重新加密，页面内容流原样搬过去

steps.en: Renumbers objects and writes a new, valid PDF (optionally linearized)
steps.zh: 重新编号对象，写出一个新的合法 PDF（可选线性化）

value.en: Merged, split, encrypted or repaired PDFs that look exactly like the originals
value.zh: 合并、拆分、加密或修复后的 PDF，看起来和原件完全一样

sources: https://github.com/qpdf/qpdf#readme (content-preserving transformations, linearization, encryption, splitting/merging; no rendering or text extraction)
https://github.com/qpdf/qpdf/blob/main/manual/cli.rst (Basic Invocation; page selection example qpdf in.pdf --pages . a.pdf b.pdf 1-z:even -- out.pdf; --linearize)
https://github.com/qpdf/qpdf/blob/main/manual/download.rst (included in most Linux distributions; GitHub release binaries)
